decision_rule.ADMITTED: the CI95 lower bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta (CELL-2 minus PLAN) is ABOVE ZERO and the CI95 lower bound of the paired intent delta exceeds -0.9943 (owner decision 99, the TRAIN lock: a gain is proven, not merely non-inferior)
decision_rule.DELTA_CONSUMPTION: item S3-4s: the per-node delta-consumption table -- how many deltas each node was supplied per row, which value_ids were supplied, and the saves and harms on the rows that received each one -- is a PRIMARY deliverable, reported whatever the verdict, placed beside CELL-1's own table, and is what decides whether there is an iteration 3 and what it retains. The PLANNER route is reported separately, never pooled: 4 of its 14 values survive the retention and CELL-1 measured it at 0.594 of rows supplied and never at cap.
decision_rule.FRONTIER: owner decision 75: the frontier row (official SLU-F1 delta x prefilled tokens per row x GPU hours per 1,080 rows) is reported on every verdict and placed beside the registered rows.
decision_rule.HARMFUL: a MEASURED loss on either guard (owner decision 25, Method B: a CI95 upper bound below zero, or a point estimate beyond the margin); width alone is NEUTRAL, never HARMFUL
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: both guards are non-inferior -- the SLU CI95 lower bound exceeds -1.2485 and the intent CI95 lower bound exceeds -0.9943 -- without a proven SLU gain
decision_rule.PER_SCENARIO_HARM_BOUND: owner decision 17: per-scenario intent and SLU tables over all 18 scenarios in BOTH the natural-mixture and the equal-stratum weighting, with net harmed rows per scenario and any scenario of five or more flagged. A breach is a diagnostic beside the verdict, never a gate.
decision_rule.REPLICATION: an ADMITTED result is replicated on the SAME roster before any DEV, Fold B or test read (the owner iteration rule; no DEV read is authorised by this package).
decision_rule.SECOND_LOOK: CELL-2 is read on the same TRAIN Fold A rows whose CELL-1 read chose the retained set, so its verdict is a development number (owner decisions 28, 86) and never an independent confirmation; the replicate on the same roster and then on a fresh one (Fold B or DEV) precedes any effectiveness claim.
decision_rule.TWIN: ATTRIBUTION, never admission. The twin arm is read with the same estimator against the same sealed PLAN comparator. A gain the twin reproduces within the plan's own null is FORM (the store's shape and token volume), not content, and the verdict says so and claims no content effect. A gain the twin does not reproduce is attributed to the deltas' content, with the twin delta reported beside it.
decision_rule.comparator: the sealed PLAN arm SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-V1 (official 63.6304 / 82.2222); nothing is re-flown
decision_rule.efficiency_is_reported_regardless: every efficiency deliverable is reported whatever the verdict

derivation_from_cell1: CELL-2 is a SIBLING fragment set, never an edit of CELL-1's: CELL-1's run ids, attempt ids and fit identities are sealed and consumed, and the runbook's repoint step -- which rewrites store pins in place -- is for a HELD cell, never for re-pointing a sealed identity onto new content. The release runbook was therefore run step by step (B / C / W / D / E / R) and its fill stage was not run at all.

The four baselines are CELL-1's with exactly three changes: the stage3-deltas release and snapshot pins moved to the version-2 namespaces, native_contact_fit renamed to this family's own R02 identities, and prepared_phase_supply REMOVED (the cell-P0 form; the flip mints each cell's own artifact under its own run id, item E16). Every other decided key is byte-identical to CELL-1's, so the one-factor proof against the locked plan still holds by construction.

A recovery re-registration needs BOTH a new generation attempt id AND a new native_contact_fit.attempt_id in the baseline. CELL-1 lost two relaunches to exactly this: the fit gate binds the BASELINE's fit attempt id and refuses an identity that already carries evidence. Both failure_policy strings say so.

The two smoke FIT identities are declared as held CELLS in the smoke fragment, where CELL-1 left them undeclared (cell PLAN's form). Each of this family's eight run ids therefore carries a cell, a registered plan document, an exposure row and its own core.flight.cli check. This is the only intentional shape difference from CELL-1 and it authorises nothing extra: both cells stay held and are never flown as generation cells.

No decision requirement is registered in either fragment, on purpose: core.flight.repin._upsert_decision_requirement inserts the real one at the flip and a placeholder without an expected_decision_id would refuse the campaign at load.
An aborted campaign leaves locks/flight.lock behind; the coordinator clears it before the next launch. (CELL-1's own launch record, this package's predecessor note.)

purpose: Stage-3 S3-6 CELL-2 (owner decisions 83, 99, 101, 106): the locked v2.0 plan plus ITERATION 2 of the node-targeted stage3-deltas store as ONE factor on TRAIN Fold A, comparator the sealed PLAN arm at the plan's own null (h_SLU 1.2485 / h_intent 0.9943), twin arm as the form control. Version 2 is the owner-decision-83 retention of the v1r store CELL-1 flew: 200 of 379 values kept, 179 retired, nothing else moved. PRIMARY DELIVERABLES: (1) the official paired read against the sealed PLAN arm under the decision-99 TRAIN lock rule; (2) the per-scenario effect x prefilled-token frontier table in both weightings, beside CELL-1's own; (3) the per-node delta-consumption table (S3-4s), with the Planner route reported separately because 4 of its 14 values survive; (4) the twin contrast, which decides attribution, never admission. READ DISCIPLINE: CELL-2 is a SECOND look on the same TRAIN Fold A rows that chose the retained set, so its verdict is a development number (owner decisions 28, 86) and the replicate on a fresh roster precedes any effectiveness claim.
quality_gate: no task-quality read before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered 1,080 outputs, the native phase summary and the single successful complete official TRAIN score all exist, and not before the registered STOP condition passes (the sealed PLAN and PLANr aggregates reproduce to the hundredth). The twin is read only after the arm has sealed and been read. The efficiency and delta-consumption reads may proceed from the sealed receipts, trace and server log as soon as the manifest seals, because they touch no answer, reference or quality field.

resampling.clusters: 125 speaker clusters, 18 scenarios of 60 rows, 523 headset and 557 far-field rows, from the released roster metadata
resampling.interval_form: percentile pairs of the same retained replicate sequence
resampling.pairing_note: both sides of this contrast are decoded runs, so the paired interval carries real decoding noise; the own-null margins are the calibration for exactly that. A NON-INFERIORITY read is the correct shape here precisely because the expected true effect is zero.
resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed

resume_recovery_clause: owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18. If an attempt dies of an INFRASTRUCTURE failure with code and request bytes unchanged -- never a harness or config defect -- the one allowed recovery may be a RESUME-RECOVERY under item E10 instead of a re-fly: every complete row of the aborted attempt is kept without selection, every partial or unstarted row is flown under the same run id, and the merged manifest declares the predecessor attempt with its trace hash, kept-row list and that list's hash. It changes no question, roster, factor, comparator, decision rule or cap, and the run-cumulative budget must be re-checked because a resumed attempt and its predecessor share one run id. A resumed EFFICIENCY read must additionally state the split of its GPU hours and prefilled tokens across attempts, because a merged manifest's cost is the sum of two lease windows and a per-row rate computed over the merged manifest alone would be wrong.

smoke_acceptance.compaction: THE SECOND ITEM THIS SMOKE EXISTS FOR: the E20 compaction receipts, per phase. The registered worst-case bound puts the SOLVER phase at COMPACT_REQUIRED by 317 tokens (prompt_fit above), so the smoke reports how many of its four rows actually compacted, at which phase and by how much, beside cell PLAN's own sealed zero. A non-zero count is a cost and a caveat on the frontier row's token basis, not a failure; an abstention caused by compaction IS a failure and stops the arm.
smoke_acceptance.contacts_per_row: 4 (perception, solver, reviewer, planner); at most 11 with the review loop and one revision
smoke_acceptance.delta_supply: THE ITEM THIS SMOKE EXISTS FOR: every one of the four routes actually serves, and the per-node supplied counts are recorded per row. Version 2 retires 10 of 14 Planner values and 55 of 95 Reviewer values, so a route that serves zero items on every row is an inert route and a FORM defect that stops the arm (the B9a-rec lesson, and the CELL-1 smoke's own third failure at reviewer_0_input). The Perception unconditional slice must be the same four value ids CELL-1 seeded, because all four survive the retention.
smoke_acceptance.dispositions: finite_completion and react_exhaustion counted (0 expected on four rows); no abort
smoke_acceptance.first_request_identity: the Perception request differs from cell PLAN's for the same row by exactly the added unconditional delta block and by nothing else; the Solver, Reviewer and Planner requests differ by their own added block plus upstream content
smoke_acceptance.fits: every request fits (one request-fit receipt per contact)
smoke_acceptance.normaliser: one deliver_normaliser receipt (saea-deliver-normalise-v3) per row; the four knowledge-store release and snapshot pins on every receipt
smoke_acceptance.offline_precondition: Before the smoke flies, analysis.native_episode_dry_run walks this exact composition on all four rows against the REAL released version-2 stores, contact-free, including a duplicate candidate row and a REVISE revisit, and reports the per-node supplied counts. The registered result of that walk is in this package's README.
smoke_acceptance.tools_array: absent on every request; tool_choice none; 0 tool calls
smoke_acceptance.twin_smoke: the twin smoke carries the same per-route item COUNTS as the generation smoke on the same four rows with different value_ids: the count identity is the token-matching evidence the twin's role as a form control rests on

cell1_measured_consumption_for_compariso.upper_bound_after_retention: the share of CELL-1's supplied items whose value survives retention -- perception 4,320 of 4,320 (100 %), solver 3,597 of 6,386 (56.3 %), reviewer 1,834 of 3,722 (49.3 %), planner 267 of 807 (33.1 %) -- is an UPPER bound on the reduction, because the Solver and Reviewer caps bind and refill from the remaining pool.

supply_reach.what_it_means: Every value of the released store is reachable on every node, arm and twin, exactly as at v1r. The routes are therefore not inert by construction. What the retention DOES change is how often a candidate-bound route finds a match at all: CELL-1 measured the Planner route at 0.594 of rows supplied and 1.259 items per supplied row against a cap of 4, and version 2 keeps 4 of its 14 Planner values over 4 distinct intents. The four-row smoke measures the realised per-node supplied counts before the arm opens, and the verdict reports the Planner route separately rather than pooled.
supply_reach.what_this_is: A MODEL-FREE upper bound on what each candidate-bound route can ever select, computed by intersecting each value's associated_facet_ids with the 60 registered SLURP candidate intents of prepared/SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-CANDIDATE-CONTRACTS-PREPARE-V1/catalog.json. Measured on the released version-2 snapshots by scripts/flights/batch/adv1_to_deltas_steps.py reach and written into coordination/slurp-stage3-delta-cell-r02-v1/stage3-deltas-v2-release-pins.json.

twin_factor: the same one factor as the arm, with the store pinned to the DERANGEMENT TWIN release (knowledge/slurp/semantic/stage3-deltas-twin-v2/): the same 379 statements, the same node distribution, the same token count (5,740) and the same per-row facet-count multiset, with the candidate-bound nodes' associated_facet_ids and the unconditional list's TARGET fields deranged under seed 20260922 as WHOLE attachment tuples (scripts/build_slurp_stage3_delta_twin.py). 16 of 379 rows landed on an equal facet set by arithmetic and are reported rather than refused. The twin is the FORM control: a gain it reproduces is form, not content.
